liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Minglewood Blues** (2 reviews): Bobby performs his all-time finest slide guitar work on this track; Listener calls this performance the best Minglewood ever [16][19]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jerry is on fire, causing the entire place to lift off [21]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): The song is described as beefed up and funky in the recording [17]
- **Help on the Way** (1 review): Jerry cannot remember the words, causing the jam sequence to fail [23]

## The recordings

- **gd83-09-02.sbd.unk.2174.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 181 min; rated 4.32/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's vocals are not too low in the mix on this soundboard [20]
- **gd1983-09-02.sbd.tetzeli.33819.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 181 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1983-09-02.163561.senn.421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 185 min [4]
- **gd1983-09-02.aud.donnelly.1374.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 173 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [8]
- **gd83-09-02.beyer_senn.unk.23854.sbefail.shnf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 175 min; rated 4.77/5 by 30 [11]. Said about its sound: Listener calls the audience recording one of the best sounding tapes ever [14]

## Around the show

- A tour buddy was thrown out by state troopers, tossing his stash into the crowd [15]
- Selection highlights the crucial importance of Brent Mydland's contributions to the ensemble [27]
- Listener believes the audience recording sounds better than the soundboard version [18]
- Blog describes the Boise show as an overlooked gem from 1983 [28]
- JamBase notes the concert features in a forthcoming Dave's Picks archival release [29]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd83-09-02.sbd.unk.2174.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> cassette master> (cass?)> DAT> CDR [1]. Also: Listener recommends the Beyer FOB audience version for its extra bottom end [24]
- **gd1983-09-02.sbd.tetzeli.33819.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Patched fix of shnid 2174 by Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD> cassette master [3]. Also: Bill Tetzeli fixed disc transitions and patched gaps using the FOB source [3]
- **gd1983-09-02.163561.senn.421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes [4]
- **gd1983-09-02.aud.donnelly.1374.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Extracted and posted to alt.binaries.gdead by Bob Donnelly 8/2000; source: FOB AUD PCM(dbx)>dbx decode>DAT>CD>EAC>WAV>SHN [8]. Also: The copy is missing the final It's All Over Now, Baby Blue [8]
- **gd83-09-02.beyer_senn.unk.23854.sbefail.shnf**: source: 10th Row Center 2 BeyerM160 Left & Right Channels 1 Sennheiser 421 Center ChanelSony TCD5M Cassette Master>SoundForge5 [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1983-09-02 Fri Boise State University Pavilion, Boise, ID](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1405479359318/grateful-dead-1983-09-02-fri-boise-state) [31]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Dave's Picks Vol. 27, BSU Pavilion, Boise, Idaho, 9/2/1983 | #4833501055](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-27-bsu-4833501055) [32]
- Fan art by diskunion.net: [BSU PAVILION, BOISE STATE UNIVERSITY, BOISE, ID ? 9/2/83 / GRATEFUL DEAD / グレイトフル・デッド / オールドロック | ディスクユニオン･オンラインショップ](https://diskunion.net/rock/ct/detail/DS200117-057) [33]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1983-09-02 Fri Boise State University Pavilion, Boise, ID](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1405479359318/grateful-dead-1983-09-02-fri-boise-state) [34]
- Fan art by Bobbie Bestic Grateful Dead: [1983-09-02 Boise Pavillion Boise State U., Boise, ID, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1983-09-02-boise-pavillion-boise-state-u-boise-id-usa/) [35]

claims.text: Listener calls the audience recording one of the best sounding tapes ever
A tour buddy was thrown out by state troopers, tossing his stash into the crowd
Bobby performs his all-time finest slide guitar work on this track
The song is described as beefed up and funky in the recording
Listener believes the audience recording sounds better than the soundboard version
Listener calls this performance the best Minglewood ever
Jerry's vocals are not too low in the mix on this soundboard
Jerry is on fire, causing the entire place to lift off
Jerry cannot remember the words, causing the jam sequence to fail
Listener recommends the Beyer FOB audience version for its extra bottom end
Source lineage includes SBD, cassette master, DAT, and CDR via anonymous benefactor
Bill Tetzeli fixed disc transitions and patched gaps using the FOB source
Jim Vita provided first-generation cassettes; Charlie Miller handled the transfer
The copy is missing the final It's All Over Now, Baby Blue
Selection highlights the crucial importance of Brent Mydland's contributions to the ensemble
Blog describes the Boise show as an overlooked gem from 1983
JamBase notes the concert features in a forthcoming Dave's Picks archival release
